items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I never heard of him before, but they were Smiling Billy Stewart and the Sarasota Serenaders.

ctx.x: made that picture, Check and Double Check, (inaudible). Scotty looked around and said, I believe they got us.

At that time then (inaudible), I said I'm going to be like Faulkenberg told me, get your big band, you can do it. He said go out and get your big band, and I told them you all stick with me, we're going to get a band. And so Eddie Nicholson told me, yeah, yeah, I've been telling you that and so we went on, but after all we did have a little seven piece band, we did all right, but Smiling Billy Stewart had about a ten or twelve--no, I think it was twelve or fourteen--he had a big band, it was a good band, and I…
